title: Lordship of Christ
definition: The lordship of Christ means that Jesus possesses supreme authority as risen Lord over all creation, the Church, and every life.
summary: Jesus Christ is Lord and rightly commands faith, worship, obedience, and allegiance.
christFocus: Christ's lordship is revealed in His divine identity, resurrection, exaltation, and reign.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus is not only Savior but Lord. His lordship is not a title believers add later; it belongs to who He is. He reigns with divine authority.

The resurrection and exaltation publicly declare His lordship. Every knee will bow and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord.

Christ's lordship calls for surrender. Faith in Christ is not trust in a helpful advisor but allegiance to the risen King.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people want benefits from Jesus without submission to Jesus. The lordship of Christ matters because the true Christ cannot be separated from His authority.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Confess Jesus as Lord in word and life. Submit your decisions, habits, relationships, ministry, and future to His authority.
